title: SafetyVesselStateV1
description: Payload ("data") of safety.vessel_state.updated.v1. Latest navigational safety state of a vessel: pipeline EWS status and collision risk (stream SAFETY keeps one message per vessel). Published on every change and at most every SAFETY_STATE_HEARTBEAT_S otherwise.

time.description: Time of the position the state was evaluated for

ewsStatus.description: Pipeline EWS status: 0 danger, 1 warning, 3 safe

pipelineDistanceM.description: Distance to the nearest active pipeline zone in meters; null when none is known

nearestPipelineZoneId.description: Pipeline zone the distance refers to

collisionRisk.description: Collision risk band from CPA / TCPA: none, low, medium, high

otherMmsi.description: The other vessel of the encounter

cpaNm.description: Distance at the closest point of approach (CPA), nm

tcpaMin.description: Time to the closest point of approach (TCPA), minutes

anyOf.description: Closest encounter with another vessel (CPA / TCPA)

items.description: Method id of the methodology catalog, e.g. "cii.attained"

methodIds.description: Methodology catalog ids of the methods behind the state
